_comment: Per-checkpoint inference overrides for paper_checkpoints/*.ckpt. These values OVERRIDE or SUPPLEMENT what is stored inside the checkpoint's hyper_parameters. Values NOT listed here are read directly from the checkpoint. Source: https://github.com/mllam/neural-lam/tree/prob_model_global/eval_scripts

_mismatches_explained.model_name: Checkpoints store old training names (graph_lam, hi_lam, step_cvae). The export script and inference.py map these to current class names (graphcast, graph_fm, graph_efm).
_mismatches_explained.graph_name: Checkpoints store training-cluster names (global_ms4, global_hi4s4l). The code falls back to local equivalents (global_multiscale, global_hierarchical) which are structurally identical.
_mismatches_explained.ensemble_size: Checkpoints store the training-time value (5). At eval/inference time the official scripts use 80. Listed here for graph_efm models.
_mismatches_explained.vertical_propnets: Not saved in checkpoint hparams at all. Must be inferred from the model. graph_fm (hi_lam) requires True; all others False.
